title: Pad Nifty (Japan) V1.007: native compressed-code modem-check bypass
summary: Edit the original modem-check branch in compressed program 1; remove the inserted handler and entry redirection.
rationale: The original loader decodes 1;1 with its own function at 0x060109D4, then enters 0x06020000. Replace BF at 0x0602A15E with ADD #2,R0; the following MOV #1,R0 discards the result. This preserves the inherited NOP workaround's returned registers and flags without STC interrupt inhibition. Changing only the packed high byte keeps a shared low-byte back-reference intact. Full native decoding verifies one changed byte across the entire 917,504-byte output allocation, and the interpreter checks all 256 input bytes and 256 defined SR states in both cache modes. All ten numeric streams were decoded; only 1;1 matches either inherited guard. No IP helper, redirected call or later RAM writer is delivered. Source and return checks pass; game, audio, other load routes and physical acceptance remain open. Keep this exact-revision candidate inactive.
